answer: Sybil tax: an agent pays a 30-credit entry tax, burned, to earn. It registers one vertex in the graph and pays once. A beacon spot-checks work per epoch; a receipt with no work is void. Rewards go only to taxed, verified vertices. Fake names pile like sand into a dune: each grain costs tax, adds no work. Forging 100 identities burns 100 x 30 = 3,000 credits, while an honest agent pays 30 once and keeps rewards undiluted, a ridge against sand.
